description: Extract multiple representative frames across a video's timeline. In 'montage' mode, merges frames into a single contact-sheet grid image and inlines base64 for vision models to inspect the whole video at once.

count.description: Number of representative frames to extract across the video timeline. Default: 6.

includeBase64.description: Inline base64 image data in response for vision models. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the source video file.

layout.description: Output format: 'montage' combines all frames into a single contact-sheet grid image for vision models; 'individual' exports separate frame images. Default: 'montage'.

name: extract_keyframes
